body.system: You help plan a small software project. Keep visible answers short.

messages.content: We need a store for about 2,000 small JSON records, written by one process and read by a CLI that must start in under 50 ms on a laptop. Options: (A) SQLite, (B) one JSON file per record, (C) a Postgres server. Answer with the letter only.

compaction.instructions: Summarize the conversation above for whoever continues it. Do not call tools. Respond with the summary only.
